sandstone.by.command: twoway contour depth northing easting, by(half) (half = northing > its median)

sandstone.ccuts.command: twoway contour depth northing easting, ccuts(7600(100)8000)

sandstone.ccuts.line.command: twoway contourline depth northing easting, ccuts(7600(100)8000)

sandstone.levels10.command: twoway contour depth northing easting, levels(10)

sandstone.levels10.line.command: twoway contourline depth northing easting, levels(10)

sandstone.none.command: twoway contour depth northing easting,  interp(none)

sandstone.none.line.command: twoway contourline depth northing easting,  interp(none)

sandstone.outlines.command: twoway contour depth northing easting, outlines

scatter100.none.command: twoway contour z y x,  interp(none)
